void consume(char c, bool& inParen, std::vector<int>& data) {
    if (c == '_') {
        if (inParen && data[2] != 0) {
            data[1]++;
        } else if (data[2] > data[0]) {
            data[0] = data[2];
        }
        data[2] = 0;
    } else if (c == '(') {

        if (data[2] > data[0]) {
            data[0] = data[2];
        }
        data[2] = 0;
    } else if (c == ')') {
        inParen = false;
        if (data[2] > 0) {
            data[1]++;
        }
        data[2] = 0;
    } else {
        data[2]++;
    }
}

    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::string a;
    std::cin >> a;

    bool inside = false;
    std::vector<int> d = {0, 0, 0};

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

    if (d[2] > d[0]) {

    }

    std::cout << d[0] << " " << d[1] << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
